name: Sun Frontier Fudousan Co., Ltd.
summary: Sun Frontier Fudousan Co., Ltd. provides real estate revitalization services to building owners, asset holders, and wealthy individuals in Japan. It operates through Real Estate Revitalization Business, Real Estate Service Business, Hotel and Tourism Business, and Other Business segments. The company offers replanning; property management, leasing management, asset consulting, effective land use, and consulting services; hotel development, regional revitalization, and tourism business; and overseas, and construction business.
